keyPoints: Sharir ki gatividhiyon ka niyantran aur samanvay do tantra karte hain — tantrika tantra (tez, bijli jaise sanket) aur hormone tantra (dheema, khoon ke jariye).
Mastishk ke teen mukhya bhaag hain — pramastishk (sochna-samajhna), anumastishk (santulan aur gati) aur medulla (dhadkan, saans jaise anichhik kaam).
Prativarti kriya (reflex action) bina soche-samjhe turant hoti hai — garm tawa chhoote hi haath kheench lena; isme merurajju seedha kaam karti hai.
Merurajju (spinal cord) mastishk aur sharir ke beech sandeshon ka rajmarg hai; ye prativarti kriyaon ka kendra bhi hai.
Paudhon me gati vriddhi se hoti hai — tane ka roshni ki taraf mudna (prakashanuvartan) aur jadon ka paani ki taraf badhna (jal-anuvartan) iske udaharan hain.
Adrenaline hormone sankat ya dar ke samay khoon me milkar dhadkan tez karta hai aur sharir ko ladne ya bhagne ke liye taiyaar karta hai.
Aam galti: hormone ko sirf prajanan se jodna; insulin jaise hormone roz khoon me shakkar niyantrit karte hain aur vriddhi hormone lambai badhata hai.
